EVIDENCE — option (a) implemented and merged (2026-08-22).

- Gerrit change 2130 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2130), patch set 1: LLM-Review +1 (rebar review bot, PASS) and Verified +1 (rebar CI bot, run 32604045139 SUCCESS, all four pytest cells green incl. macOS py3.13). Rebased and submitted server-side as commit 8481a057b69565908c27adfc82c76510f35620dc.
- Change: call-local dict keyed by detector source_path in _run_opengrep (src/rebar/grounding/engine_b_backends.py) — each unique YAML source validated once per invocation, result fanned out to all its detectors. No persistent/cross-scan state; scan execution, SARIF normalization, coverage records unchanged.
- AC1 (once per source_path): test_opengrep_validation_runs_once_per_source_file — written RED first (failed on pre-change code with a third duplicate validation of the shared source), GREEN after.
- AC2 (quarantine fan-out preserved): test_opengrep_shared_source_validation_failure_fans_out_to_every_detector — passed on both pre- and post-change code, locking every-detector invalid_detector abstains with per-detector detail on a shared bad source.
- AC3 (call-local only): the cache is a local variable inside _run_opengrep; no module/global/persistent state introduced.
- AC4 (no scanner removed/mocked): tests/unit/grounding/test_engine_b.py 23 passed; test_conformance.py + test_coverage_reconstruction.py 33 passed (real semgrep/ast-grep boundaries exercised).
- AC5 (option b filed): idea ticket homey-cozy-dassie / ed95-d0f5-011f-4cad, linked discovered_from this ticket, status idea — captures the caching-boundary design question (stale-result risk if the tree changes mid-run, worker-local xdist fixtures, content-addressed key/invalidation requirements, boundary-retention constraints).
- AC6 (gates): make lint exit 0; complexity ratchet active=43 new=0 increased=0; mypy 'no issues found in 638 source files' — all in the worktree .venv.
- gw0-crash datum (test_opengrep_timeout_via_harness one-off worker crash): covered by the CI-timeout lane per the operator ratification; nothing filed here.
